name: Strong Lager

flag: At least 30 days in the cold cellar
keep: Store below 25°C, out of direct light

name: Dry Lager
blurb: Crisp and clean. Karakuchi is Japanese for a dry, sharp taste: a light body, a bitterness that snaps off fast and a bone dry finish.
flag: At least 36 days in the cellar, our longest rest
keep: Store below 25°C, out of direct light
occasion: Spicy food and hot days. Anything that needs cooling down.
madeWith: Water, barley malt, rice, hops, yeast
proof: Malt and rice only. At least 36 days in the cellar, our longest rest.
highlight: Light body and a bitterness that snaps off fast.

name: IPA
blurb: Hops up front. Citrus, tropical fruit and resin, then a firm clean bitterness that lingers.
flag: Never pasteurised. Kept below 6°C from tank to tap
keep: Keep cold, below 6°C, out of light
occasion: Slow sipping for the hop crowd. Stands up to rich curries.
proof: Never pasteurised. Kept below 6°C from tank to tap.
highlight: Citrus, tropical fruit and resin, then a clean bitter finish.

name: Witbier
blurb: Soft and easy. Hazy and gently tart, with coriander, orange peel, a touch of clove and a dense white head. Lovely with food.
flag: Never pasteurised. Kept below 6°C from tank to tap
keep: Keep cold, below 6°C, out of light
occasion: A hot afternoon, light bites and long lunches.
madeWith: Water, barley malt, wheat, oats, coriander, orange peel, hops, yeast
proof: Never pasteurised. Kept below 6°C from tank to tap.
highlight: Coriander and orange peel with a dense white head.
